svg.title: How to use the auth method readiness groups
svg.desc: The runbook produces live Entra groups. The telephony-only group is the migration list you point a Conditional Access report-only policy at, hand to the service desk as a call list, and drive a registration campaign at, watching it shrink each run until cutover is safe. The phishing-resistant and strong groups nest under a System Preferred MFA parent that a policy targets. The no-method, review and non-human exclusion groups are triaged or kept out of user policies.
